arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import datetime as dt
from humanize import naturaldelta, naturaltime

# Test with very large timedelta
huge = dt.timedelta(days=999999999)
print('naturaldelta huge:', repr(naturaldelta(huge)))
print('naturaltime huge:', repr(naturaltime(huge)))

# Also test some edge cases
tiny = dt.timedelta(seconds=1)
print('naturaldelta tiny:', repr(naturaldelta(tiny)))

normal = dt.timedelta(days=365)
print('naturaldelta 365 days:', repr(naturaldelta(normal)))
"
